name: N7UniformSecp256k1X
why_it_matters: This is the uniform point-level multiplication formula x(n*P)=Phi_n(x)/PsiSq_n(x) for secp256k1. It is the missing bridge between Mathlib's division polynomials and scalar multiplication on the actual curve group.

default_budget.note: Use bounded, kernel-checked passes against one named wall at a time.
